# GitHub Copilot instructions

Read `CONTRIBUTING.md` before changing anything. It is the public development
contract for this repository: branching, commits, tests, CI, merge and release.
The maintainers keep a longer contract locally; it is not part of the repository,
so never assume it exists.

Product rules for end-user workspaces live in `engine/workspace_rules.md` and
are unrelated to repository development.
